definitions.explanation: Mimetic word for the sound of loud snoring or, by extension, for sleeping very deeply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぐーぐー⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: My father is sound asleep, snoring away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧、⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぐーぐー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}って→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was tired and ended up sleeping soundly on the sofa.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、ぐーぐー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いびき→いびき：05509_ibiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧くる。
examples.english: I can hear loud snoring coming from the next room.

notes:
Mimetic (⟦{擬音語|ぎおんご}→擬音語：22536_giongo⟧) for the sound of loud snoring or, by extension, sleeping very deeply. Often paired with ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ or ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぐーぐー⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep soundly (snoring)
- ぐーぐー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いびき→いびき：05509_ibiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かく: to snore loudly

RELATED WORDS:
The same shape ぐーぐー can also mimic a stomach growling from hunger (⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐーぐー⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧).
